paragraphs: Rabbi Elazar ben Perata, grandson of Elazar ben Perata (see Perata). A case came before Rabbi, who would follow the sages. Elazar ben Perata’s grandson told him, “Did you not teach me in the name of your forebears?”, etc. “Yes,” he replied, changing to Rabban Shimon ben Gamliel’s ruling, Jerusalem Talmud, Megillah, chapter 4, end of halakhah 4; Ketubbot, chapter 11, halakhah 6. Sanhedrin, chapter 1, halakhah 2: Gamliel, which should also be read in Megillah and Ketubbot. Gamliel of Yavneh was Rabbi’s grandfather; Shimon ben Gamliel, his father. Thus Yuchasin’s colleague-of-Rabbi notice fits, though “Did you not teach me” suggests Rabbi was his teacher. Sukkah 39a: he disputes with Rabbi.
